changelog.title: What changed in {league}
changelog.how: Every change has a short summary. Select Impact to see what it means for your character, your farming and your gear.
changelog.section.big.desc: Changes that alter how you play, farm or gear. Read these first.
changelog.section.small.desc: Number tweaks and adjustments. Skim for your build and your favourite content.
changelog.section.new.desc: Things that did not exist before this patch.
changelog.empty: Nothing in this section for the selected topic.
impact.confidence.confirmed: Follows directly from the official patch notes.
impact.confidence.prediction: Our reading of the notes and early community reports. It may change as the league develops.
builds.title: Builds for {league}
builds.lede: Each build is explained from the core idea down to the details. Read the top of an article to decide, and open the expandable parts when you need to know why.
builds.group.starter.desc: Builds that work on a fresh character with no currency, and carry you into maps.
builds.group.endgame.desc: High-budget builds to move to once you have currency.
builds.none: Endgame builds will be added once the first week of the league shows what works.
builds.budget.title: What the budget labels mean
builds.budget.note: There is no live price feed. These are rough ranges, and prices in the first week of a league move fast.
build.budget.starter.desc: Self-found gear and a few Chaos Orbs.
build.pieces.note: The build does not function without the pieces marked Must. Everything else is a strong recommendation.
build.progression.note: Five stages from level 1 to the endgame. Each says what you use, what changes, and when to move on. Open the expandable parts for detail.
build.sources.note: We read these and cross-checked them against each other and the official notes. Where they disagree, the article says so.
leveling.title: Leveling: level 1 to the end of Act 10
leveling.campaign: The whole campaign at a glance
leveling.campaign.note: Ten acts in order. Each card shows the act boss, the passive points you can earn, and the events that fall in that act: Labyrinths, resistance penalties and unlocks.
leveling.howToRead.note: Each act page draws the zones as a flow chart in travel order. Side trips branch off to the right. Every zone carries one of four labels. Select a zone to see the quest, the reward and how to handle it.
leveling.principles: Nine habits for a smooth campaign
leveling.route.note: Zones in travel order. {must} required stops, {worth} side trips worth taking, {skip} you can skip. Select a zone for details.
